notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the Family and Medical and Parental Leave Policy.

Governing documents for faculty leave are present: the Faculty Handbook temporary disability (sick leave) policy (2018_01), the Faculty Handbook leave of absence (2018_02) and the Faculty Handbook Part II tenure-clock rules (2018_04), together with the university-wide Family and Medical and Parental Leave Policy covering 'all university faculty and staff' (2018_00). So the no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply; missing = false.

There is no dedicated paid or unpaid parental leave for faculty in the saved sources. Maternity is handled as a temporary disability under faculty sick leave (c1 leave, c2 pay: full salary up to one year for Assistant/Associate/Ordinary Professors; the maternity period itself 'determined in each case upon the advice of the patient's physician', so V1 fails on length and the pay is a generic plan).

Faculty Handbook Part II .021 excludes time on 'parental leave' from the tenure clock, but no saved document defines a faculty parental leave; the 'Parental Leave' section (VIII) of 2018_00 is the DC school-event leave.
2018_01 and 2018_02 are 2015-09-11 captures accepted for the 2018 reference date (per their version notes); components citing them carry the version_uncertain flag.

FMLA substitution: 'Employees will be required to substitute paid sick leave and/or available annual leave for the first 12 weeks of FMLA leave'; paid leave counts toward FMLA. Not coded as must_exhaust_first (substitution, not prior exhaustion).

Eligibility: the policy defines eligible employees as all faculty and staff with 12 months and at least 1000 hours (the DC FMLA standard); federal FMLA eligibility coded from 29 U.S.C. 2611(2) (12 months and 1,250 hours). DC FMLA statute is not saved, so its terms are as stated by the policy (statute_verified false).

Instructors (and Associates who are officers of instruction) have full salary for the first semester of sick leave and half salary for the second; coded in c2 duration_variants, not as separate components (the tenure-stream member is coded at the professorial ranks).

Cited but not saved: Sick Leave Policy (2018_00 'Related Policies'); FMLA Forms; OGC Summary of Federal Law; DC FMLA (statute); DC Safe and Sick Leave Act text (counsel.cua.edu/DClaw/Employment/safeleave.cfm); the University's Leave Policy, Section VIII (military leave); Faculty Handbook Part III B-8 and 'the Policy of the University' on part-time service and tenure extension; Long Term Disability plan documents (ERISA Plan Documents; Summary Plan Descriptions); HR Benefits Web page; Retirement Policy. Navigation links only (not cited by any provision): Pregnancy Policy (Student Life), Reasonable Accommodations Policy (employees), Workers' Compensation Policy.

Birth parent chain: faculty temporary disability (maternity) leave 52 weeks [c1] with full-salary sick pay within it [c2]; FMLA 12 workweeks [c3] and DC FMLA medical leave 16 workweeks [c4] concurrent with c1 from the start; DC FMLA family leave 16 weeks [c5] consecutive_after c4 (S1a), inside c1's year; LTD [c13] only after 90 days and exhaustion of sick leave (no length).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks [c3] and DC FMLA family leave 16 weeks [c5] together from the birth (concurrent); faculty sick leave for family care up to 16 weeks [c6] within c5 (discretionary).

S1a reading for c5: the policy states the DC medical leave as an additional entitlement ('Such employees are also entitled to up to 16 work weeks of unpaid medical leave during any 24-month period'); the statute is not saved to confirm. It does not change the birth parent's figures, since c5 ends inside c1.
